author: Ryuji🦇⛓️| Demon Bunny Vtuber
title: Looking for artists to fix VTuber model
content:
I’m looking for artists who might be able to help me with something. 

Long story short, I commissioned a VTuber model over a year ago, but I ran into some issues with the artist. She/He kept stalling for 8 or 9 months before finally delivering the model (even though I had paid for a two-to-three-month delivery). I really don’t want to speak, work or ask this person for any more favors. 

Some parts, like the hair, are very poorly cut, it’s been a real struggle to animate because it was left in large, awkward chunks. 

I’m hoping to find someone who could help me, cause I’d really don’t want to commission an entirely new model..
